question: Whom does the practitioner touch with foot and see with eye?
premises: yaṃ yaṃ spṛśāmi pādena means whom whom I touch with foot
yaṃ yaṃ paśyāmi cakṣuṣā means whom whom I see with eye
inference: He touches and sees whomsoever with foot and eye.
plain_english: Whomsoever I touch with foot, whomsoever I see with eye.
